verdict.rationale: The evidence shows incident.io tracks actions during an incident, split into ones that need doing now and ones followed up after closure, and can sync incident actions to Asana. That covers a basic task list for live response. Nothing in the pack documents defined incident roles such as commander or comms lead, so the coordination half of the story is unevidenced. missing for 10: documented incident roles (commander, comms lead), role assignment within incidents, structured task checklists or templates, independent or hands-on corroboration
